mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE id = #{userId} AND current_challenge_id = #{challengeId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(feedback_type = 'SAME'), 0) AS same_count, COALESCE(SUM(feedback_type = 'DIFFERENT'), 0) AS different_count, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(verified_amount - ai_estimated_amount), 0), 0) AS average_difference FROM FEED_ANALYSIS_FEEDBACK ff JOIN FEED f ON f.id = ff.feed_id WHERE ff.user_id = #{userId} AND f.category = #{category} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ff.feedback_type IN ('SAME', 'DIFFERENT') AND ff.created_at >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 90 DAY)
SELECT name FROM CHALLENGE WHERE id = #{challengeId}
SELECT invite_code FROM CHALLENGE WHERE id = #{challengeId}

SELECT f.*, fa.analysis_summary, NULL AS analysis_status, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url FROM FEED f JOIN USERS u ON u.id = f.user_id LEFT JOIN FEED_ANALYSIS fa ON fa.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FEED (user_id, challenge_id, media_url, thumbnail_url, media_type, status, spending_type, saving_amount, category, custom_category, caption) VALUES (#{userId}, #{challengeId}, #{mediaUrl}, #{thumbnailUrl}, #{mediaType}, 'ACTIVE', #{spendingType}, #{savingAmount}, #{category}, #{customCategory}, #{caption})

INSERT INTO FEED_ANALYSIS (feed_id, recommended_spending_type, recommended_category, estimated_saving_amount, analysis_summary, confidence_score, reference_value, actual_cost, saving_difference, detected_items_json, price_references_json, analyzed_at) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{spendingType}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{summary}, #{confidence}, #{referenceValue}, #{actualCost}, #{savingDifference}, #{detectedItemsJson}, #{priceReferencesJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO FEED_ANALYSIS_FEEDBACK (feed_id, user_id, category, ai_estimated_amount, feedback_type, verified_amount, note) VALUES (#{feedId}, #{userId}, #{category}, #{aiAmount}, #{feedbackType}, #{verifiedAmount}, #{note})
INSERT INTO MESSAGE (challenge_id, user_id, message_type, reference_feed_id, content) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, 'FEED_SHARE', #{feedId}, NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE FEED SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{feedId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT like_count FROM FEED WHERE id = #{feedId} AND challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FEED WHERE id = #{feedId} AND challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE FEED_ANALYSIS SET recommended_spending_type = #{spendingType}, recommended_category = #{category}, user_confirmed_saving_amount = #{savingAmount}, feedback_type = 'ADJUSTED' WHERE feed_id = #{feedId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MESSAGE (challenge_id, user_id, message_type, reference_feed_id, content) VALUES (#{challengeId}, #{userId}, #{type}, #{feedId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, m.message_type, m.reference_feed_id, m.content, m.created_at, f.media_url, f.thumbnail_url, f.media_type FROM MESSAGE m JOIN USERS u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN FEED f ON f.id = m.reference_feed_id AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.id = LAST_INSERT_ID()

SELECT m.id, m.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, m.message_type, m.reference_feed_id, m.content, m.created_at, f.media_url, f.thumbnail_url, f.media_type FROM MESSAGE m JOIN USERS u ON u.id = m.user_id LEFT JOIN FEED f ON f.id = m.reference_feed_id AND f.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE m.challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND (m.reference_feed_id IS NULL OR f.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY m.created_at
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saving_amount), 0) FROM FEED WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
